Located 20 minutes north of Miami Beach in the heart of Aventura, Starting

Fairmont Turnberry Isle Resort & Club mixes country club charm with Wednesday 27/7 the sleek styling of a boutique hotel. The 392-room property is home to

two Raymond Floyd-designed golf courses and the Laguna Pool, which at 8pm BST features a water slide, a lazy river and cabanas outfitted with TVs and aS = refrigerators (this is Miami, after all). With its family-friendly vibe, Turnberry Isle falls somewhere between Grossinger's in the Catskills (at its legendary height) and a posh island resort.
